Consistency — the canonical patterns (27 groups judged)

the norm a new file in each directory should follow. Only 1 real drift · 27 groups w/ deviations (mostly intentional)
api/lib/barkpark_web/components/fields/
Each file defines a Phoenix functional component module using `use Phoenix.Component`, exports named component functions with `attr` declarations and `~H` HEEx templates, and is named with the `_field` suffix matching its public function name.
api/lib/barkpark_web/controllers/
Files are named *_controller.ex, define a module using `use BarkparkWeb, :controller`, and implement action functions (index, show, create, etc.) delegating to Barkpark context modules. Snake-case filenames map 1:1 to PascalCase module names.
api/lib/barkpark_web/live/studio/plugins/
Files use `use Phoenix.Component` and expose function components (with `attr` declarations) that delegate rendering to lower-level component modules. They act as thin adapter surfaces for the Studio UI.
api/lib/barkpark/plugins/onixedit/web/
Files are Phoenix LiveView modules using `use BarkparkWeb, :live_view`, named with the `_live.ex` suffix, implementing `mount/3`, `handle_event/3`, and `render/1` callbacks for admin UI surfaces.
api/lib/barkpark/sharing/
Files are Ecto schema modules: each uses `use Ecto.Schema` and `import Ecto.Changeset`, defines a `schema` block with typed fields, and exposes a `changeset/2` function. The module name matches the singular resource name.
api/lib/barkpark/tasks/
Files are Oban workers that use Oban.Worker, import Ecto.Query, and alias Barkpark.Content/Repo to run periodic background jobs (TTL sweeping, compaction) against task documents.
api/lib/barkpark/tenancy/
Files in this directory are Ecto schema modules: they use `use Ecto.Schema` and `import Ecto.Changeset`, define a `schema` block with fields and associations, and expose a `changeset/2` function.
api/lib/barkpark/webhooks/
Files in this directory are Ecto schema modules: they use `use Ecto.Schema` and `import Ecto.Changeset` to define a database-backed struct with a changeset function. A new file here should follow the same schema/changeset shape.
api/priv/repo/migrations/
Snake-cased Elixir migration modules (e.g. 20240101_create_foo.exs) each containing a single module that uses Ecto.Migration and defines up/down or change callbacks.
api/priv/static/assets/
Files are kebab-cased JS modules prefixed with 'bp-' (e.g. bp-graph.js, bp-media-picker.js), each a self-contained browser component bundled for the Studio UI.
api/test/barkpark/
Test modules use `Barkpark.DataCase` (which sets up the database sandbox) and are named with snake_case `_test.exs` suffix. The majority of tests in this directory exercise code that reads or writes to the database.
api/test/barkpark_web/
Files use `BarkparkWeb.ConnCase` and make HTTP assertions via the shared conn/sandbox setup it provides. Tests are named `*_test.exs` in snake_case.
api/test/barkpark_web/components/fields/
Each file is an ExUnit test module using `use ExUnit.Case, async: true`, importing Phoenix.LiveViewTest, and aliasing the specific field component under test plus relevant Content/SchemaDefinition modules. Tests are purely in-memory with no database dependency.
api/test/barkpark_web/live/studio/
Files use BarkparkWeb.ConnCase (which imports Phoenix.LiveViewTest and Barkpark.Content), mount a LiveView via live/2, and assert against rendered HTML or LiveView events. They are integration tests that require a real Plug conn and database.
api/test/barkpark_web/plugs/
Each test file uses `use BarkparkWeb.ConnCase` (with async: false) and calls the plug under test via a private helper that invokes `Plug.call/2` on a `build_conn/1`-constructed conn; database and auth fixtures are set up in `setup` blocks when needed.
⚠ drift: optional_token_test.exs — Switch from `use Barkpark.DataCase` to `use BarkparkWeb.ConnCase` so the test gets the standard conn helpers (`build_conn/2`, router) consistent with every other plug test in this directory.
api/test/barkpark_web/studio/
Snake-cased ExUnit test modules that use ExUnit.Case (async: true) and alias BarkparkWeb.Studio modules directly; tests are pure unit tests with no database dependency.
api/test/barkpark/papers/
Test modules in this directory use `Barkpark.DataCase` (with `async: false`) and import tenancy/content fixtures to exercise database-backed paper operations with full repo isolation.
api/test/barkpark/plugins/media/
Test modules use `Barkpark.DataCase` (with `async: false`) and alias both `Barkpark.Plugins` and `Barkpark.Content` to exercise plugin behaviour against a real database, with a `setup` block that registers the plugin and seeds codelists.
api/test/barkpark/plugins/onixedit/
Test files use `use ExUnit.Case, async: true` and alias specific OnixEdit submodules; they are pure unit tests with no database or job-queue dependencies.
api/test/barkpark/plugins/onixedit/bokbasen/
Test modules use `Barkpark.DataCase` (with `async: false`) and alias `Barkpark.Plugins` to exercise database-backed plugin behaviour. Files are snake_case `*_test.exs`.
api/test/barkpark/search/
Test modules use `Barkpark.DataCase` (with async: true) and alias `Barkpark.Search`; they exercise search features that interact with the database (events, crystals, interactions, synonyms).
api/test/barkpark/sheets/
Test modules use `use Barkpark.DataCase` (with `async: false` for GenServer/DB tests), alias `Barkpark.Sheets` and `Barkpark.Content`, and test stateful session behaviour backed by the SQL sandbox.
api/test/mix/tasks/
Mix task tests use `use ExUnit.Case, async: false` with `alias Mix.Tasks.<Module>` and rely on Mix.Shell.Process for output capture. Files are named after the mix task they test using snake_case.
api/test/support/
Files are ExUnit case templates named with a `_case` suffix, using `use ExUnit.CaseTemplate` to define reusable test case setups (conn, data, registry).
internal/apiclient/
Files are predominantly _test.go files (package apiclient) that import encoding/json, net/http, testing, and net/http/httptest to exercise the client. The two non-test files are the production implementation; a new test file here should follow the _test.go naming and table-driven test style of peers.
js/docs/
Root-level config files in js/docs use framework-conventional names (next.config.mjs, source.config.ts, next-env.d.ts) with no shared use/import signature — this is a Fumadocs/Next.js app whose top-level files follow framework conventions rather than an internal naming scheme.
js/packages/react/tests/
Test files are named after the React component they exercise (Pascal-cased, e.g. Image.test.tsx, Reference.test.tsx) and use .tsx since they render JSX via createElement/renderToString with vitest.

Architecture — layering & duplication (verified)

Compile-DAG acyclic. Verified layering back-edges:
acceptableapi/lib/barkpark_web/controllers/export_controller.exRepo.transaction is used solely to hold an open DB transaction for chunked HTTP streaming — a transport-layer concern that the Content context cannot own; the actual data access goes through Content.export_stream.
violationapi/lib/barkpark_web/controllers/listen_controller.exreplay_since builds raw Ecto queries against MutationEvent and Document with tenant-scoped joins directly in the web controller, bypassing any domain context. — fix: Move replay_since/3 into Barkpark.Content (or Barkpark.Tasks for the task-event variant) and call it from the controller.
violationapi/lib/barkpark_web/controllers/tasks_controller.exThe prime/2 action builds multi-table Ecto queries against Document and MutationEvent directly in the controller, duplicating domain query logic that belongs in Barkpark.Tasks. — fix: Add a Tasks.prime/2 (or Tasks.dashboard/2) function that encapsulates the in_progress, events, and lifecycle_counts queries, and call it from the controller.
violationapi/lib/barkpark_web/studio/pane_builder.exresolve_graph_doc/3 constructs a full scope-aware Ecto query with Content.Scope and Barkpark.Repo.one directly in the web/studio layer instead of delegating to a Content context function. — fix: Add Content.resolve_document(doc_id, dataset, scope_kw) that encapsulates this query, and call it from pane_builder.
violationapi/lib/barkpark/content/cross_validator.exCrossValidator aliases BarkparkWeb.Components.Fields.Visibility for its predicate logic, inverting the dependency arrow from core into the web layer. — fix: Move the predicate/operator logic from BarkparkWeb.Components.Fields.Visibility into a shared core module (e.g. Barkpark.Content.Predicates) and alias that from both CrossValidator and the web component.
violationapi/lib/barkpark/media/search_intelligence.exSearchIntelligence aliases BarkparkWeb.V1.MediaSearchParams — a pure param-parsing struct — directly in a domain module, creating an upward dependency on the web namespace. — fix: Move MediaSearchParams into Barkpark.Media (e.g. Barkpark.Media.SearchParams) and update the alias in both the domain module and any web callers.
acceptableapi/lib/barkpark/plugins/bulldocs.exThe BarkparkWeb references appear exclusively inside register_routes/1, which is the Barkpark.Plugin callback whose sole job is to return route tuples naming web modules — this is the documented plugin route-highway pattern.
acceptableapi/lib/barkpark/plugins/sheets.exBarkparkWeb references are confined to register_routes/1, the Plugin behaviour callback that must name web controllers and LiveViews by design — identical to the bulldocs/tasks precedent.
acceptableapi/lib/barkpark/plugins/tasks.exBarkparkWeb.TasksController is referenced only inside register_routes/1, the Plugin behaviour callback for route declaration — this is intentional and documented as the plugin highway pattern.
